children: Florida-based EverBank Financial has reached a deal to pursue a reverse merger with WaFd
, a smaller bank in the Pacific Northwest, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday citing a statement from the companies.
The deal would create a regional bank with some $75 billion in assets, the report added.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
